mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.accounts (id, account_type, username, password_hash, staff_member_id, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountType}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{staffMemberId}, #{status})

INSERT INTO public.account_roles (account_id, role_id, granted_by, granted_at) VALUES
(#{grant.accountId}, #{grant.roleId}, #{grant.grantedBy}, #{grant.grantedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(substr(username, char_length(#{base}) + 1) AS bigint)), 0) FROM public.accounts WHERE starts_with(username, #{base}) AND substr(username, char_length(#{base}) + 1) ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
